Spiritual King of Ignition, Valnout
Trigger Unit｜ -｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 50000
(You may only have one [Over] trigger in a deck. When revealed as a trigger, remove that card, draw a card, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] +100 Million until end of turn! If revealed during drive check, activate its additional effect!)
Additional Effect - Choose one of your [Stand] rear-guards, and it gets "[AUTO](RC)[1/turn]: At the end of the battle this unit attacked, [Stand] this unit." until end of turn. If you did not choose a card, draw a card, choose up to one unit card from your hand, and call it to (RC).
